title: 밤실 공방 이미지 에셋
notes: Source master pack; lazy-load individual scenes and poses. No 8MB initial-load or mobile performance claim.
These are static key poses; not a rig or validated flipbook.
Do not let ribbon fill the hollow release center. Tie knots are not onset cues.
Original game/reference/textbook PNGs and commercial music are excluded.
Raster source provenance and prompts remain in generation manifests; text/symbol mathematics come from deterministic vector source.
